race.comment: FOUR INTHE MORNING (4) started at $1.30 and toyed with her rivals on debut last start over 1400m at this track, scoring by over five lengths after taking charge a long way out. Confident she can take this next step and make it two from two. MAGURTZ (2) has been in the money at both runs this prep, the latest offering a game second after leading most of the way over 1450m at Muswellbrook. Has a strong third-up record and coming back a little in trip looks a positive move. CHAMBER OF SECRETS (6) stalked the pace then went home a shade too well recently over a similar trip to this at Muswellbrook. Drawn to enjoy another lovely run so although getting up in the weights she cannot be underestimated. WHITTELLO SUN (9) missed the kick and was never a factor first-up over 1000m at Muswellbrook last start. Won over this trip second-up last prep so a much better run is on the cards. ODE SO MUCH (1) just failed to hold off CHAMBER OF SECRETS last time out. Will give another bold sight.
